LESSON: READING ALOUD

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: MANDARIN
Strand: Reading
Topic 2.2: Reading Aloud
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading Aloud, part of Reading in Grade 6 MANDARIN.

Key inquiry question: How can you enhance comprehension when reading aloud?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. read aloud titles related to nuclear family members from flashcards,

2. work jointly to locate vocabulary about nuclear family members from a crossword puzzle then read them aloud,

3. arrange jumbled up flashcards of numbers 30-100 and read them out in turns,

4. role-play reading simple texts on the introduction of nuclear family members by their name and age,

5. read the poem on family aloud for peer assessment,

6. read out the titles of nuclear family members in Kiswahili and Chinese and compare their pronunciations (e.g.爸爸

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. read aloud titles related to nuclear family members from flashcards,
2. work jointly to locate vocabulary about nuclear family members from a crossword puzzle then read them aloud,
3. arrange jumbled up flashcards of numbers 30-100 and read them out in turns,
4. role-play reading simple texts on the introduction of nuclear family members by their name and age,
5. read the poem on family aloud for peer assessment,
6. read out the titles of nuclear family members in Kiswahili and Chinese and compare their pronunciations (e.g.爸爸

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading Aloud together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Learning to learn: The learner works collaboratively with peers when they role-play introducing their nuclear family members

appropriately.

Values:
Responsibility: The learner engages in assigned roles and duties as they jointly locate and read words from a crossword puzzle.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Peer education and Mentorship are nurtured as the learner reads poems on the theme for feedback from their peers.

Link to other learning areas:

The learner links their learning to Religious Education on the concept of the role of members in a family.
